assignmentNote: optimal lineup by confidence-weighted shrunk role winrates, all 120 permutations scored
duoLaneNote: carry+support on the same team actually share a lane; mined from each member’s last ~150 ranked matches, 10+ duo-lane games required
triosNote: from each member's last 50 ranked matches (295 distinct matches since 2026-03-23); older trio games are outside this window — duos are all-time
notes: The lineup above is worth about +3.1 wins per 100 team games versus everyone queueing their usual role.
Cuban Noobster moves to carry: 56.8% over 191 games beats their queue habit (offlane).
Goldilocks324 moves to offlane: 52.7% over 107 games beats their queue habit (carry).
Strongest duo: Cuban Noobster + Goldilocks324 at 57% over 269 ranked games. When only two queue, prefer this pair.
Stack synergy: queued together the stack averages 53%, against a 51% career baseline — queueing as a stack is worth real wins.
honesty: role winrates are career-wide, adjusted toward each player’s own average so thin samples don’t overclaim
pair winrates count ranked games where both were allies; they include games with randoms filling the rest
trio records come from a recent-match window, not all-time history
hero suggestions require 10+ of the player’s own games on the hero in that exact role (real 5v5s only); samples under 20 games show their count
